description: Creature category: animal | forage | carcass | nest | remedy
Display name shown in the UI and narration
Emoji icon displayed on the encounter card
Card CSS class controlling visual styling: food | threat | predator | prey | poison | minor | primate
Whether the player can investigate this encounter to gain Field Journal knowledge
Narration text shown when the encounter first appears this turn
Text shown after the player investigates (normaliseEncounter provides a generic default if absent)
Up to 3 progressive investigation hints shown at knowledge tiers 1–3 (tier index = array index)
Extra flavour line shown on the encounter card below the main seen text
Structured natural-history block: { title, fieldNote, behaviour, ecology, gameplayInsight, scienceNote }
Poison payload applied on contact or consumption; null if none. Fields: { severity, rank, toxinType, lethal, turns, damage, warning[, criticalTimer] }

Spawn-weight dict mapping layer names to base probabilities: { layerName: chance, ... }. Use empty object {} for trigger-spawned creatures (guardians, same-species spawns) that never appear via random roll. Valid keys: Ground | Undergrowth | Mid-storey | Canopy

Hidden-subtype pool replacing the global hiddenSubtypePools entry for this creature. Array of { label: string, weight: number[, poison: object|null][, energy: number][, alcohol: object] }. Absent if this creature has no subtype variation.
Five-element array of progressive knowledge descriptions shown at tiers 1–5 (displayed in the Field Journal for notable creatures)
Combat type determining resolution logic: minor | bite | sting | tail | spines | claw | kick | pinch | predator | fatal | grapple | venomous_ambush | toxic_food | rival | fight
Behaviour archetype controlling AI responses: skittish | defensive | still | ambush | dominant | hunter | territorial | swarm
Combat hit-points for this creature (higher = harder to kill or subdue)
Relative body mass (dimensionless); feeds food-yield and combat calculations
Movement speed 0–100; affects whether the player can flee or catch this creature
Evasion 0–100; affects whether attack rolls land
Attack drive 0–100; determines pursuit rate and unprovoked attack frequency
Energy granted when this animal is killed and eaten
Active pursuit mode for predators: ground | air | wateredge | climber (absent on non-pursuing creatures)
Runtime-assigned sex: male | female. Set by normaliseEncounter; deliberately absent on invertebrates.
Number of times this resource can be consumed before exhaustion
Energy granted per portion consumed (0 on non-food resources such as water or clay)
Energy granted from nest contents when raided (absent on some nest types)
Hydration restored per portion (default 0 when the field is absent)
Alcohol effect on fermented items: { rank: number, turns: number, label: string }
Scavenger-draw intensity; higher values increase the risk of predator attention while the player feeds
Per-visit chance 0–100 that the carcass degrades to inedible
Number of egg portions obtainable from this nest
Encounter key of the guardian creature that may defend the nest when disturbed
Probability 0–100 that the guardian spawns when the nest is disturbed (required if guardianKey is present)
Remedy specification: { type: string, cures: string[] } — lists the toxin types this resource can counteract
